maxTokens.description: Reviewer reply budget in tokens. Thinking blocks count against it on reasoning upstreams; too small a cap truncates the reply mid-think (the empty-reply machinery failure).

mode.description: The leniency ladder for the reviewer's non-allow verdicts, strictest first. Hard-tier denies (riskLevel high|critical, or missing) always deny. Soft-tier denies (low|medium) and the model's own uncertainty map per mode: 'strict' — both deny, the reviewer's allow is the only pass; 'default' — deny soft denies, uncertainty asks; 'advisory' — both ask: you decide everything except the reviewer's hardest calls, which stay final; 'lenient' — soft denies ask, uncertainty passes; 'permissive' — both pass, only hard-tier denies block. Reviewer machinery failures never map to allow: they deny under strict and permissive, and defer otherwise.

notifyLevel.description: The minimum ambient (review-loop) notification level that still notifies the operator; 'off' silences all ambient notices. Command feedback (the /ai-guard surface) is never gated. With denials having no host dialog, 'off' or 'warning' means model denies (and clarifications, at 'warning') reach only the agent and the audit log.
